summary: Phase 2 Social Features comprehensive testing. FIXED 2 bugs: (1) chat_wrapped.py route ordering - /recap/available-periods was being matched by dynamic /recap/{period} route, (2) posts.py, channels.py user lookup - queries used {user_id: ...} but email-auth users have _id=email without user_id field. All 27 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend pages verified: Channels, Feed, Chat, Keypad, Account with BottomNav navigation.

fixed.issue: Route ordering bug - FastAPI matched 'available-periods' as the {period} parameter. Moved static route before dynamic route.
User lookup used {user_id: ...} but email-auth users have _id=email without separate user_id field. Posts/comments showed 'Unknown' author. Fixed with $or query to lookup by _id, email, or user_id.

critical_code_review_comments: Data model inconsistency: email-auth users have _id=email, no user_id field. Google/OAuth users may have different structure. Consider normalizing user_id field across all auth providers.
The 4 missing frontend pages (CreateChannelPage, ChannelDetailPage, CreatePostPage, PostDetailPage) are critical for complete Phase 2 functionality - users cannot create channels or posts from the UI
Route ordering in FastAPI: Static routes (e.g., /recap/available-periods) must come BEFORE dynamic routes (e.g., /recap/{period})
